# 1 Enoch Chapter 97 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Epistle of Enoch — Woe Oracles

---

**1** Know that the sons of men shall be made to swear by the great oath in the midst of the holy ones, and that they shall give the holy ones to eat; and the sons of heaven shall be their judges in those days, and they shall swear before them.

**2** And in those days none shall be saved by gold or silver, and none shall be able to escape.

**3** There shall be no iron for war, nor shall you put on a breastplate; bronze shall be of no service, tin shall be of no service and shall not be valued, and lead shall not be desired.

**4** All these things shall be rejected and destroyed from the surface of the earth when the Elect One appears before the face of the Lord of Spirits.

**5** Woe to you who work godlessness and boast of your glory; who devour your own souls, who eat the best fruit of the earth and count it as righteousness.

**6** Know therefore that you shall be delivered into the hands of the righteous, and they shall cut off your necks and slay you, and shall have no mercy upon you.

**7** Woe to you who rejoice at the tribulation of the righteous, for no grave shall be dug for you.

**8** Woe to those who set at nothing the words of the righteous, for you shall have no hope of life.

**9** Woe to those who write down lying and godless words, for they write their lies that men may hear them and act godlessly toward their neighbor.

**10** Therefore they shall have no peace but shall die a swift death.

---

*LOGOS notes: Vv. 3–4 present a remarkable eschatological disarmament: when the Elect One appears, all metals used for warfare will be abolished. This is an Enochic development of Isaiah 2:4 ("they shall beat their swords into plowshares"). V. 9's oracle against scribes of lies is theologically pointed — the very medium of the Epistle (written instruction) is being contrasted with false writing.*
